title: Implement Transaction System: Separate buttons for Pemasukan, Pengeluaran, Aset, Hutang, Piutang
completion_summary: Implemented 5 separate transaction buttons (Pemasukan, Pengeluaran, Aset, Hutang, Piutang) with double-entry accounting
acceptance_criteria: UI has 5 separate buttons: Pemasukan, Pengeluaran, Aset, Hutang, Piutang
Pemasukan (Income) creates cashflow with debit to Asset account
Pengeluaran (Expense) creates cashflow with credit from Asset account
Aset (Asset) shows asset accounts for selection
